badrinath.title: Char Dham registration required
badrinath.banner_message: Pre-registration or permit required for this destination
badrinath.details: Pilgrims traveling to Badrinath during the yatra season must complete biometric registration and carry valid ID. Check current government advisories for road status and health requirements.
documents: Medical fitness certificate (if mandated for the season)
Emergency contact and travel insurance details
weather_warnings: Sudden temperature drops above 3000 m—carry thermal layers.
Check Alaknanda valley road status before departure.

kedarnath.title: Kedarnath trek registration
kedarnath.banner_message: Pre-registration or permit required for this destination
kedarnath.details: The trek to Kedarnath requires advance registration through the official portal. Helicopter and pony services may have separate booking rules. Respect carrying limits and waste policies on the trail.
documents: Travel and accommodation proof for base villages
Medical certificate when notified by authorities
weather_warnings: Afternoon cloud build-up—start early on trekking days.
Carry rain cover and traction aids on steep stone sections.
